manualReview.scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0104; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Yes, today is busy and Today is free after six are understandable controlled A1 scheduling utterances.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently maps today to «امروز».

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Tomorrow is busy is a relevant time-reference contrast.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: The utterances remain short and bounded despite the after-six transfer.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The second learner turn changes the available time while retaining today.

overallCoherence.evidence: Calendar scenario, target, translations and assessment remain aligned.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
The review covers only the bounded A1 target sense of today.
